data: What does the blue cross represent in the graph?

The blue cross represents the F1 score for the Greedy method. This can be inferred from the legend of the graph, which indicates that the blue cross corresponds to the Greedy method. Additionally, the table on the right side of the graph provides the F1 scores for different methods, including the Greedy method, which is represented by the blue cross.
